method.kind: Focused source change with generated in-memory/temp-file controls
method.limitations: This is a DXF-only reference-closure slice. It does not establish DWG-specific field behavior, full view-family graph closure, native CAD acceptance, external semantic support, or general version conformance beyond the tested serializer target matrix.

formatEvidence.observation: Group 345 identifies a named AcDbUCSTableRecord. Group 346 identifies the base UCS when orthographic type 79 is nonzero; if absent in that case, the base is WORLD. Orthographic types are 0 through 6.

Group 72 indicates an associated UCS; UCS fields including 79, 345, and 346 appear only when it is set. Group 345 identifies a named UCS; 346 identifies the base UCS for nonzero orthographic type, otherwise omitted base means WORLD.

adapterValidation: VPORT orthographic type is constrained to 0 through 6.
Nonzero VPORT base-UCS references require nonzero orthographic type and resolve uniquely to a retained UCS row.
VIEW references/orthographic data cannot be serialized when hasUCS/group-72 is false; active UCS type is constrained to 0 through 6.
Nonzero named/base targets resolve uniquely to typed UCS records; base references require nonzero orthographic type.
References are refused when the selected DXF target would not emit the fields.
writerBehavior: VPORT and VIEW code-345/346 handles are remapped through remapObjectHandle().
Standalone table-entry writers fail closed for unrepresentable or internally inconsistent UCS references.
implementation.compatibility: No public interface virtual, public class layout, or DWG parser/encoder was changed.
